title: She Walked Out
the_thought: He thought a woman was a man who had lost something.

levels.name: The Short
beats: The hour is not over. Sigmund Freud keeps the folder. Cream board. Red ribbon. He thought a woman was a man who had lost something. He published the girl who walked out. Then he drew a map that started with the boy. A colleague said the map was backwards. He kept the first picture. He still called women a dark continent. A hole in the paper. The full video is the walkout, the map, and the riddle he never answered.
